name: RUEG German subcorpora via DAKODA
attribution: RUEG / Research Unit Emerging Grammars in Language-Contact Situations; DAKODA reprocessed version
redistribution_policy: DAKODA marks the selected RUEG German subcorpora as open under CC0 1.0. RhymeLab stores source provenance and keeps downloaded archives local/gitignored.
corpus_version: DAKODA version handed over by Martin Klotz on 2023-02-08

ingestion_policy.purpose: Detailed local register evidence from the attested DAKODA EXB text surface, with a separate normalized layer only when an upstream export actually provides one.
ingestion_policy.matching: Exact normalized lexical-token sequence against existing modern-eligible RhymeLab phrases on each actually available text layer.
notes: The real DAKODA RUEG EXB archives use category=text for the attested participant/source surface and spacy_mixtral_th1_merged empty span events for clause/sentence boundaries.
RhymeLab stores that category=text surface in the existing dipl_text compatibility slot; this is a storage-field mapping, not a claim that DAKODA labels the tier dipl.
The supplied DAKODA EXB archives do not contain a separate norm tier. RhymeLab leaves norm_text empty rather than duplicating or inventing normalization.
Nested DAKODA JSON metadata supplies document formality, mode, speaker age/id, document language and creation date where available.
RUEG is a register sensor, not a population-representative German frequency corpus.
